description: Call this once when you start working for a person, on any task (a site, a database, a domain, a document, not only UI). Returns how to read what they mean (fast or dictated messages, odd words), when and how to ask, how to hand them a step they must do themselves (sign-ins, clicks, payments) so they can find it, and how to report. Pass a situation to get the most relevant rules first.

situation.description: Optional: what's happening, e.g. 'my human must approve a sign-in link' or 'reporting a step that failed'

name: ihumane_human
title: Work well with your human
